# Branched evolutions through the EvolveChoice radio group: Eevee into Flareon (item 4),
# Wurmple into Silcoon (no "from" name in the message), Tyrogue ("Tyrouge")
# cancelled with "Don't evolve".
party 133 30
party 265 7
party 236 20
> start
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> choose 1
dialog information "# 133 Eevee, L.30, XP:27000, XP to next level:2791" -> OK
dialog information "Please select what you would like to evolve your Eevee to." -> OK
> radio Form4.EvolveChoice 4
> click Form4.EvolveButton
dialog information "Eevee evolved into Flareon!" -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> choose 2
dialog information "# 265 Wurmple, L.7, XP:343, XP to next level:169" -> OK
dialog information "Please select what you would like to evolve your Wurmple to." -> OK
> radio Form4.EvolveChoice 2
> click Form4.EvolveButton
dialog information " evolved into Silcoon!" -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> choose 3
dialog information "# 236 Tyrogue, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog information "Please select what you would like to evolve your Tyrouge to." -> OK
> radio Form4.EvolveChoice 1
> click Form4.EvolveButton
dialog information "Evolution cancelled." -> OK
> state
